summary: Shenmue entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Shenmue
entries.definitive_edition: Shenmue I & II on PC, with Dreamcast comparison documented if needed

emulation.emulator: Flycast or redream only for Dreamcast comparison
emulation.notes: Native PC collection preferred for current route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Dreamcast hardware for historical route; PC collection for current capture route

primary.version: Shenmue I & II PC collection, with Dreamcast-original caveats documented
primary.why: Shenmue I & II is the current PC route for the first game, adding modern resolution/control options and dual audio, while the Dreamcast original remains the historical fidelity baseline. The PC collection omits or changes some details, so edition must be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use Shenmue I & II on PC for the modern route. Record storefront/build, original versus modern controls, language/audio, resolution, frame-rate/mods, save/date/time state, arcade/minigame state, and whether Dreamcast was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original hardware route and exact original presentation
secondary.why: PC collection is current and convenient but not identical to Dreamcast.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record edition, control mode, audio language, aspect/cutscene behavior, and any mods.
